created_for: Original DEV 160 + E1 DEV expansion 160, before any 1-5y pair generation
count_definition: Necessary-condition upper bound: subject has at least one eligible positive and at least one eligible negative event on its frozen preassigned axis. No year-gap inspection is permitted at this gate.

failure_action.action: Freeze one whole new outcome-blind DEV expansion wave E2 before pairing.
failure_action.why_whole_wave: Preserve the predeclared expansion design. Do not oversample PROJECT after observing that PROJECT is the remaining deficient axis.

pass_action.action: Only then generate 1-5y local opposite-polarity pairs and run nuisance gates.
